materialOpportunity: Turn the free-profile attorney cohort into a personalized, measurable, privacy-minimized launch operation without weakening trust or collecting client matter facts.
implemented: One-time raw link display and hash-only token storage
Allowlisted aggregate public and attorney funnel events
Raw-token removal from browser URL after validation
Owner metrics and aggregate CSV export
sharedLearning: Personalized outreach should reuse a known contact rather than create duplicate professional records.
Invitation state is operational evidence, not professional verification, eligibility or endorsement.
Conversion measurement should answer launch questions with aggregate counters before collecting granular visitor data.
Bearer tokens should be random, time-limited, revocable, hash-only at rest, and removed from the visible URL after validation.
No public campaign measurement needs legal narratives, IP addresses, device fingerprints, email addresses or cross-site identifiers.
